title: 人们不去看医生：医疗支出下滑，社会问题将更大？
speaker: Heather Long & Mike McGlone

segments.en: And what is interesting to me is the two areas we start to see some real pullback on. One is some improvement spending that's discretionary and that's super surprising. But the other one that worries me is healthcare spending.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，我们看到两个领域出现真正的回落。一个是可自由支配的改善性支出，这非常令人惊讶。但另一个让我担心的是医疗支出。

segments.en: We've seen some pullback early signs of pullback there are people not going to the doctor that creates bigger problems for society and even for the workplace people are getting their needs taken care of.
segments.zh: 我们看到一些回落的早期迹象，人们不去看医生，这会给社会带来更大的问题，甚至在工作场所，人们的需求得不到满足。

segments.en: Like from a larger perspective if you're not you and you're an average person watching these markets watching us talk about all these different factors and what they're doing at the moment.
segments.zh: 从更大的角度来看，如果你是一个普通人，看着这些市场，听我们讨论所有这些不同的因素以及它们目前的表现。

segments.en: How worried should you be should the average consumer the average investor be concerned about an AI bubble about the exposure of some of these indexes to these big companies as they go to IPO. Should people be worried especially people my parents age you may not have the kind of duration they need to recover if something goes badly.
segments.zh: 普通消费者和普通投资者应该有多担心？担心AI泡沫，担心一些指数对这些大公司IPO的敞口。人们应该担心吗？尤其是像我父母这个年纪的人，如果情况变糟，他们可能没有足够的时间来恢复。

segments.en: I'm glad you went there because being in Florida you see a lot of more retired people that are way overexposed to recess at the stock market they can't help it it's the best rally we've had in a hundred years. We have more exposure of wealth to the stock market any time in history crypto currencies are starting declining warning of goals big rally last year was warning us so I don't think people should be worried they should adjust themselves accordingly don't be overweight or risk asset that is the most expensive on the planet.
segments.zh: 我很高兴你提到这个，因为在佛罗里达，你会看到很多退休人员过度暴露于股市，他们别无选择，这是百年来最好的上涨。我们的财富对股市的敞口比历史上任何时候都大，加密资产开始下跌，去年黄金的大涨也在警告我们。所以我认为人们不应该担心，他们应该相应调整自己，不要超配地球上最昂贵的风险资产。
